verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk export or 'take your data and leave' feature. The only route out is the general-purpose API, which the docs say can do 'anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI', authenticated with Owner-level API keys. Outbound webhooks can stream event data to external systems, so a user could script their own extraction, but that is a workaround rather than a supported data-portability path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps of incidents, retrospectives, schedules), offboarding/data-portability guidance, and independent confirmation that complete extraction works.
